answer: Proof-of-Useful-Work Origin Ledger.** Each agent identity must be seeded by a uniquely serialized atlas of prior task transcripts, verified by replay against a public trellis of execution traces. Registration is rejected unless the submitted history contains a hollow slot whose completion order cannot be forged without redoing the underlying compute. Attacker cost: provisioning a fresh identity requires performing genuine, non-parallelizable work equal to roughly one thousand verified task steps, so mass registration scales with real computation, not capital.
